payload.core_composition_summary: Single greedy sorting mechanism: sorts disliked songs by p descending to assign lowest q, sorts liked songs by p ascending to assign highest q, minimizing total absolute difference.
payload.rationale: The algorithm uses a single greedy sorting approach to assign new ratings. Sorting is performed with a specific order derived from an exchange argument, but it does not combine multiple distinct algorithmic families. Dictionaries are used only for index lookup, not as a combined mechanism.
